name: TC-20-corrective-maintenance-scenario
description: TC-20.1: Corrective Maintenance End-to-End Scenario — Condition detection → MR → WO → Safety Permit → Completion chain

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.1 — Step 1: Condition Detection
doc_metadata.caption: The corrective maintenance scenario begins with condition monitoring detecting an anomaly. A vibration reading exceeds the critical threshold, triggering the maintenance chain.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.1 — Condition Monitoring Alert
doc_metadata.caption: Condition monitoring records show the escalation from Normal → Warning → Critical. Critical conditions trigger maintenance request creation.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.1 — Step 2: Maintenance Request
doc_metadata.caption: A high-priority maintenance request is created to address the critical condition. The MR includes the asset reference and failure description.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.1 — MR Linked to Condition
doc_metadata.caption: The maintenance request references the condition monitoring alert. After approval, a maintenance order and work order are generated.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.1 — Step 3: Work Order Execution
doc_metadata.caption: A corrective work order is generated from the maintenance order. The WO tracks labor, parts, equipment, and safety permit requirements.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.1 — Work Order with Resources
doc_metadata.caption: The work order shows assigned resources (labor, parts, equipment), linked safety permit, and workflow progression through Requested → Approved → In Progress → Closed.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.1 — Step 4: Safety Permit
doc_metadata.caption: A safety permit is issued for the corrective work order. The permit ensures proper safety protocols (LOTO, PPE) are followed during repairs.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.1 — Safety Permit for Corrective Work
doc_metadata.caption: The safety permit detail shows hazards, precautions, and the linked work order. Active permits must be verified before work begins.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.1 — Step 5: Failure Analysis
doc_metadata.caption: After completing the corrective work, a failure analysis is created to document root cause, remedy, and prevention measures.

doc_metadata.title: TC-20.1 — Root Cause Analysis
doc_metadata.caption: The failure analysis records severity, occurrence, and detection ratings. The RPN (Risk Priority Number) score prioritizes corrective actions. 5-Why and Fishbone templates support structured root cause analysis.
